titles.en: Havoc Condition Manager - Solo Play Expansion

image_type: UI layout renders with sample configurations; not gameplay screenshots

summaries.en: Requires SoloPlay; supports Realms. Select Havoc, Auric/Maelstrom and event conditions, environments and 1–5x spawn multipliers. Reduces unnecessary native-mode Lua work while preserving original spawning rules and Buff IDs.
summaries.zh-CN: 以 SoloPlay 为前提，支持 Realms。选择浩劫、金级／大漩涡、活动词条、环境及1–5倍刷怪。减少原版模式中不需要的 Lua 工作，保留原版刷怪规则和 Buff 编号。
summaries.zh-TW: 以 SoloPlay 為前提，支援 Realms。選擇浩劫、金級／大漩渦、活動詞條、環境及1–5倍刷怪。減少原版模式中不需要的 Lua 工作，保留原版刷怪規則和 Buff 編號。

main_file_description: Requires SoloPlay; supports Realms. Select Havoc, Auric/Maelstrom and event conditions, environments and 1–5x spawn multipliers. Reduces unnecessary native-mode Lua work while preserving original spawning rules and Buff IDs.
